name: tj49 child_process nested spawnSync error is an Error and error undefined stays undefined
source: import cp from "node:child_process"; function main(): void { const r = cp.spawnSync("nonexistent-cmd-xyz") as any; console.log(r.error instanceof Error, r.error.code, r.error.errno, r.error.path, r.error.message); const o: any = cp.spawnSync("sh", ["-c", "exit 0"]); console.log(o.error === undefined); }
